content.title: About
content.content: Coffee, cafe con leche is a hot beverage made from espresso, steamed milk, and a touch of sugar. It is popular in Latin American countries and is often served in cafés as a light breakfast or afternoon drink.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The name “café con leche” comes from Spanish and literally means “coffee with milk”.
In Spain and Latin America the drink is usually served in large ceramic cups.
Adding milk mellows the bitterness of coffee, making it more approachable for children.
Some regions use whole milk, others opt for skimmed or plant‑based milks (soy, almond, etc.).
Coffee, as we know it, became popular in Europe in the 19th century after being exported from the colonies.

items.title: Energizing effect
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, improving alertness and reducing fatigue.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee is rich in polyphenols that help combat free radicals and may lower the risk of certain chronic diseases.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Caffeine can boost metabolic rate and aid in calorie burning.

items.title: Calcium from milk
items.content: The milk component provides calcium, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Coffee contains small amounts of vitamins B2 and B3, which play roles in energy metabolism.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat after caffeine consumption.

items.title: Increased acidity
items.content: Coffee can aggravate acid reflux in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: The milk in the drink may cause discomfort for those who cannot digest lactose.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: Sugar raises the calorie count and can contribute to dental caries.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve hot immediately after preparation. Optionally sprinkle cinnamon or add a dash of vanilla for extra aroma. For a vegan version, replace dairy milk with soy, oat, or almond milk.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store ground coffee in an airtight container in a cool, dry place, and keep milk refrigerated and use within 5 days. Use fresh ingredients each time you prepare the drink.
